The case for buying is weak, and the brief mostly argues against it.

The positives: the curve looks organic. Bundle share is 4.3%, top-3 holders own 7.1%, there was no airdrop dump, and it has 1,190 buyers. The 30-minute return is flat (+0.9%).

The problems are larger. The last 15 minutes show net selling of 15 SOL, with sell volume (245 SOL) exceeding buy volume (230 SOL) and 591 sellers against 683 buyers. The price is down 34.6% over that window, and it sits 47.5% below its 30-minute high. Post-graduation, sells nearly matched buys (ratio 0.96), and the launch bot was present. Demand is being absorbed, not growing.

Against the base rates, an organic label and a flat 30-minute return do not offset active distribution at a 47% drawdown. I see no honest case that real demand will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. Recommendation: skip. Round-trip costs of 1.4-5.1% would also make a recovery bounce hard to profit from even if one occurred.
